title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11d — Historical Integrity relocation bridge
goal: Let the current trusted base validate exactly one legacy or Post-stage Historical Integrity layout and recognize the frozen destination before the authorized physical relocation.
acceptanceCriteria: The current complete legacy layout remains active and production entry points remain unchanged.
Base-owned verification selects exactly one complete legacy or stage-owned Historical Integrity layout and fails closed for missing, partial or ambiguous layouts.
Policy candidate validation selects the manifest from the explicit head Git tree and validates it with the base engine without fallback.
The policy registry recognizes only direct JSON children in the frozen destination directory and creates no authority file.
The subsequent physical relocation removes the temporary migration entry and registers the exact final manifest.
